notes.title: Changelog for 20.04.2025: New horror events & Gameplay improvements
notes.content:
[b]Horror System[/b]
[list]
[*] Implemented [b]TriggerUnexpectedViewChange[/b] horror event with a black and white visual effect.
[*] Implemented [b]ghost possession[/b] horror event with a nausea effect.
[*] Implemented [b]AcousticParanoia[/b] for new horror audio cues.
[/list]

[b]Interaction & Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Implemented a [b]new interaction system[/b].
[*] Implemented [b]AutoMovePlayerToLocation[/b]
[*] Updated [b]flashlight[/b] and [b]drawer[/b] interactions to use the new system.
[/list]

[b]Audio & Visual Enhancements[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Reduced ceiling light volume[/b] and improved sound attenuation.
[*] Added [b]ambient sound for Level 01[/b].
[*] Improved [b]camera transitions[/b] from the main screen to the settings TV.
[/list]

[b]UI & Lobby Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed localized text for [b]lobby search[/b] could not be found.
[*] Fixed [b]multiple clicks[/b] on the back button in the lobby.
[*] [b]Removed the option[/b] to select only one player in lobby creation.
[/list]

notes.title: Changelog for 16.02.2025
notes.content:
[b][Gameplay][/b]
• Improved player movement
- Added smoother animations: Idle, Walk, Sprint and turn in place

• Improved stamina system 
- Stamina now gets properly replicated to all players on the server
- Player switches to walk mode if stamina is to low
- Stamina now increases and decreases properly

• Improved Aburn Lurker
- Plays dynamic footstep sounds that are being played at the foot location (patrolling and chasing)
- Scream sound is being played after a player has been caught

• Improved interaction system
- Dynamic sounds are being played after picking up items
- Door locked sound being played if the player has not the key for the section 

• Implemented playable metahuman characters (2 Women and 2 Men)
• Implemented smooth camera transition between levels with dynamic sounds
• Implemented subtitle system

[b][LEVELS][/b]
• Improved level "MainMenu"
- Made a environment inside a lost place
- Implemented 3D UI interactions (single and multiplayer) camera smoothly goes to the assigned location based on the clicked option

• Improved level "Lobby"
- Implemented 3D UI interactions
- Made a environment with a hidden room in the underground

• Improved level "1"
- Performance and graphics has been improved
- Added more rooms (including special room for Aburn Lurker)
- Made the level bigger

[b][UI][/b]
• Improved interact widget
- Added interact icon to the interact widget that dynamically gets changed based on input (keyboard or controller)

• Improved PauseMenu
- Implemented controller support
- Players are able to save and load a game if they are playing singleplayer

• Improved inventory
- UX has been improved
- The design overall has been improved

• Improved multiplayer screen
- UX has been improved
- The design overall has been improved
- Increased performance for lobby search
- Implemented validation for custom lobby code
- custom lobby code is hidden at the start of the lobby. status is changeable to visible or hidden
- custom lobby code can be copied now

• Improved options screen 
- UX has been improved
- The design overall has been improved
- Added controller support
- Added 5 new taps: "Video", "Graphics", "Gameplay", "Controlls" and "Audio"

• Implemented toggle fps counter

notes.title: Changelog for 02.01.2024
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay[/b]
• Open/close door improved
- As soon as the player has the correct key in the inventory and tries to open the door, the key is inserted 
   into the door and removed from the inventory. A sound is played at the location of the door as soon as 
   the player either opens/closes the door or does not use a key and tries to open the door
• Players see as soon as a player sprints
• Players can now walk/run in all directions
• New animations for player movements
• Walking and running
• AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution 3 (FSR 3) added
• Proximity Voice Chat

[b]UI[/b]
• Interaction circle has been enlarged
• Small info text is displayed as soon as you look at an item

[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
• Discord status
- Game duration is displayed
